photoConsent.title: Photos and videos
photoConsent.granted: Your parent has said photos and videos of you may be included in session reports and used by School of Gaming, Lynx Educate and Roblox. A Gedu will still ask you before taking your photo.
photoConsent.notGranted: Your parent has said photos and videos of you are not to be used, so a Gedu will keep you out of session photos. Only your parent can change this.

mcp.title: Connect an AI app
mcp.description: Manage Sogverse from your own AI app through Sogverse’s MCP server.

steps.add: In your AI app’s settings, add a custom connector or remote MCP server with this URL.
steps.signIn: Sign in with your admin account and choose Allow.
steps.unsure: Not sure where to add it? Ask your AI app how to add a remote MCP server by its URL.
